messages:
Jack: Quick sync — Summit table + micro-talks next week. Need final plan for booth flow, who mans which slot, and how we capture leads so handoff to sales is smooth.
Maria: I can own lead capture and routing. thinking QR + short form -> auto-route to SF sales queue.
Neha: Any constraints on tabletop real estate? we only get a 6ft table, power outlet on left.
Oliver: Table + 2 chairs confirmed. We have 1 sidebar banner and a demo laptop.
Becca: Speaker roster: 3 micro-talks (10m each) per day. We need rotation schedule and speaker backups.
Jack: Ideal: 11:15, 1:30, 3:45. Each slot 8m talk + 2m Q. People sign up to man post-talk demos for 15m.
Samira: I'll do first slot Tue. Neha can cover Wed midday, Oliver will do a demo shift after 1:30 slot.
Neha: I can do Wed. Also submitted lightning talk abstract to organizer — status: pending.
Becca: For lead capture — prefer short form (email + company + interest tag). Use two QR codes: 1) quick signup (email only) 2) demo request (calendar slot).
Maria: Routing rules: quick signup -> marketing nurture list; demo request -> SDR queue (SF). Use UTM param summit2026.
Jack: Good. Add a fallback: if SDR queue full then route to rotation pool.
Maria: I'll set webhook to our /inbound-summits endpoint. Draft payload:
```json
{
  "email": "",
  "company": "",
  "interest": "demo|benchmarks|pricing",
  "source": "summit2026-booth"
}
```
Neha: Who can print the QR table cards? ops-darryl-bot?
ops-darryl-bot: I can pick up prints from local vendor. Please upload final artwork by EOD Friday.
Becca: Swag order placed, PO# PO-4492. Quick details:
```
Stickers: 250
T-shirts: 300 (S:60 M:120 L:90 XL:30)
Enamel pins: 120
Notebooks: 150
Stress-balls: 100
```
Jack: Nice. Reminder: don't hand out too many shirts first day — we want variety across days.
Samira: Also ordering a small 2ft collapsible shelf for demos. Ops estimated $45 on Amazon.
Maria: Calendar-bot, can you create micro-talk slots and demo shifts in shared calendar?
calendar-bot: Created event series 'Summit Microtalks' with slots 11:15, 13:30, 15:45 for 3 days. Invites sent to participants.
Oliver: Logistics checklist: transit box with banner, laptop + charger, HDMI dongle, spare battery, business cards, table QR holders, sign-in tablet. Who packs?
Jack: Ops (Darryl) + Becca to pack. Becca can bring a utility kit (tape, gaffer, multi-tool).
Becca: I'll also bring printed 50 physical signup cards for folks who don't scan QR.
Neha: Speaking submission update: organizer asked for headshot + 3-sentence bio. I uploaded both to portal.
Maria: For post-event follow-up: draft email templates (nurture, demo-confirm, no-show) — I'll put in marketing drive.
Jack: One more: bench narrative board at booth — we need 2 slide prints: cost/latency win, and routing/fallback diagram. Who designs?
Oliver: I can mock slides, send PDF by Thursday.
Becca: Confirmed timeline: final artwork/artifacts due Friday EOD; swag delivery Wed morning; ops packing Thurs; team travel Fri evening.
Samira: Any final compliance checks for data capture? Legal sign-off needed?
Maria: Legal approved minimal form + privacy link. Will add short consent line.
Jack: Perfect. Thanks team. If anything slips, ping #marketing and @ops-darryl-bot. :rocket:
